paper_title: Bridging Cognition and Emotion Empathy-Driven Multimodal Misinformation   Detection
caption: Results of Ablation Study

annotations.annotation: The bar charts illustrate the accuracy percentages for different methods on the PHEME and PolitiFact datasets. Each chart contains six bars representing the categories: "Ours," "w/o comments," "w/o text," "w/o select," "w/o emotion," and "w/o cognition," placed along the horizontal axis. The vertical axis, labeled "Accuracy (%)", uses a linear scale ranging from 75% to 95% with tick intervals of 2.5%. In the PHEME chart, the bars are colored in shades of red, orange, yellow, gray, light blue, and dark blue. The "Ours" method reaches the highest value at approximately 89.84%, followed by "w/o comments" at 86.82%, whereas "w/o text" is the lowest at about 80.10%. "w/o select" is at 88.80%, followed by 87.34% of 'w/o emotion' and 87.17%. In the PolitiFact chart, similarly colored bars depict accuracy, with "Ours" at about 90.57% "w/o comments" at 85.95%,"w/o text" at approximately 83.02%, followed by "w/o select" at 89.62%, "w/o emotion" at 84.91% and finally "w/o cognition" with 87.74%. The bars in both charts are sorted in no particular order, and no additional visual emphasis or annotations beyond the values labeled at the top of each bar. The groupings indicate performance variations in each set without hierarchy or prioritization inferred from the visualization.
